title: Onye Na-ekesa Amamihe Na-adịghị Adịgide
intro: Onye a na-asọpụrụ, onye a maara maka nghọta miri emi na ndụmọdụ amamihe ha, nyere ndụmọdụ gafere ọgbọ dị iche iche. Okwu ha, nke e dekọrọ n'akwụkwọ nsọ dị nsọ, na-eduzi ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu maka ekele, ndidi, na omume ziri ezi.
clues: E nyere m amamihe, ọ bụghị amụma.
Agwara m nwa m banyere mmehie kachasị ukwuu: iso Allah na-akpakọrịta.
Akụziri m gbasara ibu ọrụ, ọbụna uru mkpụrụ mọstad, na otu Chineke ga-esi mee ka ọ pụta ìhè.
Ekwusiri m ike na ekele dịrị Allah na ndị mụrụ mmadụ, na-aghọta nsogbu dị n'ịzụlite nwa.
Ndụmọdụ m gụnyere ikpe ekpere, inye iwu maka ihe ọma, igbochi ihe ọjọọ, na inwe ndidi n'ihe na-eme mmadụ.
A kpọrọ otu isiakwụkwọ dị na Quran aha m, nke nwere ihe m kụziri na ihe mmụta m kọọrọ.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
